notes: Each scenario has an 'observe' field describing what the LLM should look for when reviewing the frame.

scenarios.name: TUI Boot
scenarios.description: TUI launches and shows the prompt input
scenarios.observe: Kiro logo renders cleanly, welcome message visible, status bar shows agent name + model + cwd, prompt input ready with placeholder text

scenarios.name: Slash autocomplete dropdown
scenarios.description: Typing / shows autocomplete with available commands
scenarios.observe: Dropdown appears below input, shows command names with descriptions, (+N more) count at bottom, no visual glitches in the dropdown border

scenarios.name: /help command
scenarios.description: Show available commands panel
scenarios.observe: Help panel opens with all commands listed, subcommands shown with ⌙ prefix, search filter at top, ESC to close hint at bottom, scrollable with ↓ more indicator

scenarios.name: /help --legacy
scenarios.description: Show classic help text
scenarios.observe: Classic help text renders inline (not in a panel), lists commands with descriptions

scenarios.name: /clear command
scenarios.description: Clear conversation history
scenarios.observe: Conversation messages disappear, prompt returns to initial state, no error message

scenarios.name: /model picker
scenarios.description: Open interactive model picker
scenarios.observe: Model picker shows all available models with credit multipliers and descriptions, auto is selected by default (❯ marker), search filter at top, ESC to cancel

scenarios.name: /model select specific
scenarios.description: Select a model by typing its name
scenarios.observe: Model switches, status bar updates to show new model name

scenarios.name: /agent picker
scenarios.description: Open agent picker to browse available agents
scenarios.observe: Agent picker shows all agents (built-in + global + workspace), descriptions visible, search filter at top

scenarios.name: /agent swap <name>
scenarios.description: Swap to a different agent at runtime
scenarios.observe: Agent swaps to kiro_planner, status bar updates to show [plan] prefix. Use Shift+Tab to return to previous agent.

scenarios.name: /context show
scenarios.description: Display context rule configuration and matched files
scenarios.observe: Context panel shows active agent name, file rules with token percentages, session rules section, tips at bottom, Tab to switch to /usage

scenarios.name: /context add
scenarios.description: Add a context rule
scenarios.observe: Confirmation that rule was added, /context show should now list the new rule

scenarios.name: /context remove
scenarios.description: Remove a context rule
scenarios.observe: Confirmation that rule was removed

scenarios.name: /context clear
scenarios.description: Remove all context rules
scenarios.observe: All session rules cleared, /context show should show empty session rules

scenarios.name: /tools panel
scenarios.description: View tools and permissions panel
scenarios.observe: Tools panel shows all tools with Name, Source, Status, Description columns. All default to 'approval required'. Search filter at top. ESC to close.

scenarios.name: /tools trust
scenarios.description: Trust a specific tool for the session
scenarios.observe: Confirmation message 'read now trusted', /tools panel should show read as Trusted

scenarios.name: /tools untrust
scenarios.description: Revert a tool to per-request confirmation
scenarios.observe: Confirmation that read is back to per-request, /tools panel should show approval required

scenarios.name: /tools trust-all
scenarios.description: Trust all tools for the session
scenarios.observe: All tools trusted, /tools panel should show all as Trusted

scenarios.name: /tools reset
scenarios.description: Reset all tools to default permissions
scenarios.observe: All tools back to default, /tools panel should show approval required

scenarios.name: /mcp panel
scenarios.description: View MCP servers panel
scenarios.observe: MCP panel shows configured servers with Name, Status (● running), Details (tool count). Search filter at top.

scenarios.name: /compact command
scenarios.description: Summarize conversation to free context
scenarios.observe: On empty conversation: 'Conversation too short to compact'. After conversation: shows compaction summary with token savings.

scenarios.name: /chat new
scenarios.description: Start a fresh conversation
scenarios.observe: Conversation resets, messages cleared, new session ID assigned, prompt ready

scenarios.name: /chat new with initial prompt
scenarios.description: Start fresh conversation with an initial prompt
scenarios.observe: New session starts AND the initial prompt is sent immediately, agent responds

scenarios.name: /chat resume
scenarios.description: Resume a previous session (backend command)
scenarios.observe: KNOWN GAP: TUI interprets 'resume' as a session name, not a subcommand. Session picker is accessed via --resume-picker CLI flag. May show 'Session not found: resume'.

scenarios.name: /usage command
scenarios.description: Show billing and credits
scenarios.observe: Usage panel shows credits bar, plan info, overage status, estimated cost. Tab to switch to /context.

scenarios.name: /hooks command
scenarios.description: View context hooks
scenarios.observe: Hooks panel shows configured hooks count. If none: 'No hooks configured'.

scenarios.name: /code status
scenarios.description: Show LSP server status
scenarios.observe: Shows workspace path, detected languages, markers, LSP server list with install status (● running, ○ not_installed, ○ available)

scenarios.name: /code overview
scenarios.description: Get workspace structure overview
scenarios.observe: Workspace overview renders with directory tree and file descriptions

scenarios.name: /quit command
scenarios.description: Exit the interactive chat session
scenarios.observe: TUI exits cleanly, no error output. Run this last or restart Knight Rider after.

scenarios.name: /chat save
scenarios.description: Save current session to a file
scenarios.observe: Confirmation that session was saved to the specified path

scenarios.name: /chat load
scenarios.description: Load a previously saved conversation
scenarios.observe: Session loaded from file, previous messages restored in conversation

scenarios.name: /editor command
scenarios.description: Open editor to compose prompt
scenarios.observe: SKIP in headless — opens $EDITOR. Verify command is recognized (no 'Unknown command').

scenarios.name: /reply command
scenarios.description: Open editor with last assistant message
scenarios.observe: SKIP in headless — opens $EDITOR. Verify command is recognized.

scenarios.name: /plan command
scenarios.description: Switch to Plan agent
scenarios.observe: Agent switches to kiro_planner, status bar updates. Use Shift+Tab to return.

scenarios.name: /knowledge show
scenarios.description: List knowledge base entries
scenarios.observe: Shows knowledge base entries or empty state. Experimental feature.

scenarios.name: /paste command
scenarios.description: Paste image from clipboard
scenarios.observe: SKIP in headless — needs clipboard. Verify command is recognized.

scenarios.name: /prompts list
scenarios.description: List available prompts
scenarios.observe: Shows available prompts from MCP servers, or empty state if none configured

scenarios.name: /issue command
scenarios.description: Create GitHub issue or feature request
scenarios.observe: Opens issue creation workflow or shows instructions

scenarios.name: Read tool execution
scenarios.description: Agent uses read tool to list directory
steps: prompt:list the files in the current directory
scenarios.observe: Read tool indicator appears (◔ Read), auto-approves for read operations, directory listing renders in response, credits shown at bottom

scenarios.name: Shell tool execution
scenarios.description: Agent uses shell tool
steps: prompt:run echo hello world using the shell
scenarios.observe: Shell tool shows approval dialog with command preview, trust tier picker (Full command / Partial / Base / Entire Tool)

scenarios.name: Write tool approval dialog
scenarios.description: Agent uses write tool, shows diff and approval
steps: prompt:create a file called /tmp/kiro-smoke.txt with the text hello
scenarios.observe: Write tool shows approval dialog with file path, diff preview showing new content, approve/deny options

scenarios.name: Cancel during response
scenarios.description: Ctrl+C cancels in-progress request
steps: prompt:explain quantum computing in extreme detail
scenarios.observe: Streaming stops, 'Cancelled streaming' message appears, prompt returns to ready state, no state desync

scenarios.name: Send prompt after cancel
scenarios.description: After cancelling, a new prompt can be sent
scenarios.observe: Second prompt is accepted and processed normally, no 'Prompt already in progress' error

scenarios.name: Basic back-and-forth
scenarios.description: Send a prompt, get response, send follow-up
steps: prompt:what is the capital of France?
scenarios.observe: First response mentions Paris, second response mentions Berlin. Agent maintains context from first question. Both messages visible in conversation history.

scenarios.name: Context retention across turns
scenarios.description: Agent remembers context from earlier in conversation
scenarios.observe: Agent remembers the name from the first message and uses it in the second response

scenarios.name: Clear then new conversation
scenarios.description: /clear resets context, new conversation starts fresh
steps: prompt:remember the code word is ALPHA
scenarios.observe: After /clear, agent should NOT know the code word. Response should indicate it doesn't have that context.

scenarios.name: Long streaming response
scenarios.description: Agent generates a long response with streaming
steps: prompt:list 10 programming languages with a one-sentence description of each
scenarios.observe: Response streams in progressively, scroll works, all 10 languages visible (may need scrolling), credits shown at end

scenarios.name: Markdown rendering in response
scenarios.description: Agent response with code blocks and formatting
steps: prompt:show me a hello world in python with a code block
scenarios.observe: Code block renders with syntax highlighting, proper indentation, language label visible. Markdown bold/italic renders correctly.

scenarios.name: Trust → use → untrust → re-approve flow
scenarios.description: Full trust lifecycle for a tool
scenarios.observe: Trust: 'shell now trusted'. Untrust: shell reverts to per-request. Full lifecycle works without errors.

scenarios.name: Trust all then reset
scenarios.description: Trust all tools then reset to defaults
scenarios.observe: Trust-all: all tools trusted. Reset: all tools back to approval required. No stale state.

scenarios.name: Subagent spawn via prompt
scenarios.description: Ask agent to use a subagent for a task
steps: prompt:use a subagent to list the files in /tmp
scenarios.observe: Subagent spawns with progress indicator, live status updates visible, results returned to main agent. May show subagent approval dialog.

scenarios.name: Ctrl+C twice exits
scenarios.description: Double Ctrl+C exits the TUI
scenarios.observe: First Ctrl+C may show cancel hint, second exits cleanly. Run last or restart Knight Rider after.

scenarios.name: Up arrow command history
scenarios.description: Up arrow recalls previous input
scenarios.observe: Previous input 'hello world' appears in the prompt input field after pressing up arrow

scenarios.name: Ctrl+J multi-line input
scenarios.description: Ctrl+J inserts newline for multi-line prompt
scenarios.observe: Input field expands to show two lines, cursor on second line. Both lines visible in the prompt area.

scenarios.name: Ctrl+S fuzzy search
scenarios.description: Ctrl+S opens fuzzy search for commands and context files
scenarios.observe: Fuzzy search overlay opens, can type to filter commands and context files, Tab to select multiple
